integrity: The analytic proof establishes the global radial optimum, its unique detector-width peak and low-sensitivity asymptotics. A standalone Python checker supplies exact-rational algebra and direct spatial-integration diagnostics; independent scientific validation has not been performed. Historical priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: The theorem optimizes expected distinct-individual detection only within two symmetric planar placements; Gaussian activity centres, half-normal conditional independent sensors and fixed baseline sensitivity are assumed. It is not an unrestricted planar-placement theorem, an estimator-precision optimum or a field-calibrated prescription.
title: A sharp co-location transition and a unique best detection range for two symmetric ecological cameras
